prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 2 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1055; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck from the side while the patient was turning left. Complaints were of neck pain with stiffness and low back pain with muscle tightness. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the kind and force of the impact described. Examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness in the lumbar region, supporting the reported strain. Other testing, including neurological screening and straight leg raise, was within normal limits. No prior injury to the cervical or lumbar spine is known to this provider. Conservative management consisted of over-the-counter analgesics, gentle range-of-motion exercises, and a home stretching program. Care followed a typical course, with symptoms steadily improving and visit frequency tapering off after the second visit. Billed services reflect the two visits provided, with no duplicate charges. Prognosis is good with continued home exercise. Patient may return as needed if symptoms recur.
